conviction_note: The Q3 numbers are new: nothing was pre-released and no Información Privilegiada was filed before the print. But the bar is unsourced (no Q3 consensus could be found), the 2026 guide was held in July despite a large Q2 EBIT beat, and the capital markets day with the new plan is on 25 Nov, outside the window. So abs_move is sized at 5% for new numbers on a well-covered large cap whose guide will probably be reiterated, and p_up stays near 50 (52). Findings sum +0.1 and the scaled number is +0.2; they agree in sign and both are close to zero, which is the honest answer.

Q2 EBIT 198m vs 173m consensus and 160m R4e; the guide was held 'because the new team prefers to wait' (Renta 4)

Most likely the 2026 guide is reiterated, with any upgrade or new targets deferred to the 25 Nov CMD. A raise or an 'upper end' remark is the upside tail. H1 EBIT of 316m leaves only ~384m for H2 against a 198m Q2

positioning_check: Register not covered for this market: the CNMV short-position grid returns no rows from this container. Nothing is known about short interest, and that is not a zero. Vozpópuli (2026-10-28) reports CNMV holdings of Goldman Sachs 7.6% and ING 5.6%, mostly through financial instruments, which the company excludes from its long-term holders. That is derivative and hedge exposure of unknown direction, not a short reading. The buyback ended mid-October (CapitalMadrid headline 2026-10-14, via Google News; not fetched), so no issuer bid sits under the print. priced_lean_pct is the 20-day run-up (+8.9%), which is also the free control.

findings.finding: The 2026 guide (EBIT >700m) was held in July after H1 EBIT of 316m and a Q2 EBIT of 198m that beat consensus by 14%. Only ~384m is needed in H2, below two quarters at the Q2 run-rate. Renta 4 says management held the guide only because the new team wanted to wait, which leaves room for a raise, 'upper end' language or a firm-up at Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY25 results with the 2026 guide (26 Feb 2026): +21.3% close-to-close. Q2 2026, a big EBIT beat with the guide held: +7.1% (23 Jul 2026). Q1 2026, a miss vs consensus with the guide held: -0.7%. Q3 2025, short of operating forecasts with the guide held: -1.5%.
findings.original_quote: La directiva mantiene las guías 2026 a pesar de la buena evolución ya que entendemos que el nuevo equipo prefiere esperar tras llevar muy poco tiempo al frente de Indra. [Management keeps the 2026 guidance despite the good performance, as we understand the new team prefers to wait, having been in charge of Indra for very little time.]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is +8.9% over 20 days and near the 65-66 EUR resistance (Expansión, 19 Oct), which looks like an upgrade being anticipated. The new team scheduled its CMD for 25 Nov, so a guide change at Q3 is not the base case. If the market expected a raise tomorrow, the stock would be through 66 rather than stalling under it. Kept small because the bar is unsourced and the most likely outcome is a reiteration.
findings.independence: Company primary document with the same arithmetic: https://www.indragroup.com/cms-content/2026/07/260723-PR-Indra-Group-Results-2Q2026.pdf (Q2 EBIT 198m, 'reaffirms all of its financial targets')

findings.finding: The 1.97bn VAC tracked-vehicle contract, awarded in Feb 2026 to TESS Defence (51.01% Indra), has been frozen for months because TESS's offer was about four times the expected price. The CEO said on 26 Oct it 'should be signed before year-end' on a September re-proposal. The government has given no date. This raises questions on the call about backlog quality and TESS margins (TESS already dilutes group EBITDA margin by ~0.9pp in H1).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior on backlog-quality news at a print. The day El País broke the price dispute (21 Oct) the stock closed +1.3%. The 23 Oct -3.5% day carried the Telefónica cloud-JV story and sector moves, so it cannot be attributed.
findings.original_quote: Tess Defence, consorcio liderado por Indra ... presentó una oferta notoriamente por encima del precio previsto. Concretamente, con un coste cuatro veces mayor, según fuentes gubernamentales. ... 'Antes de final de año debería firmarse'. [Tess Defence, the Indra-led consortium, submitted an offer notably above the expected price, specifically at four times the cost, according to government sources. ... 'It should be signed before year-end'.]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it ran in El País and Cinco Días in the last 8 days and the stock did not fall on it. What is unpriced is only whether the release or call adjusts backlog or TESS provisions. If the market feared that, the stock would have sold off on 21 Oct rather than rising.
findings.independence: El País original report: https://elpais.com/economia/2026-10-21/defensa-frena-el-inicio-de-un-proyecto-de-casi-2000-millones-porque-el-consorcio-liderado-por-indra-pedia-cuatro-veces-mas.html (same reporting group, so not fully independent)

findings.finding: On 29 Sep the new chairman dismissed five senior executives and merged Defence and Space into a new operating model. Severance and restructuring costs probably land in Q3 'other operating income and expenses', which carried -17m of restructuring in H1, below the operating margin line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Restructuring has been a recurring line (-17m H1 2026, -20m H1 2025) and has never been the story of a print.
findings.original_quote: Indra Group reorganiza su Comité de Dirección para adaptarlo a su nuevo modelo operativo [Indra Group reorganises its Management Committee to fit its new operating model]
findings.why_not_priced: Small and below operating margin, so analysts treat it as noise. It is sized at a fraction of the same money as operating profit because it has no path to the guide.
findings.independence: El Nacional preview, 26 Oct: 'afronta estas cuentas después de adaptar su comité de dirección al nuevo modelo operativo' https://www.elnacional.cat/oneconomia/es/empresas/indra-encara-resultados-ultima-estrategia-frenar-operacion-em-e_1714831_102.html

findings.finding: On 27 Oct the Council of Ministers lifted spending limits so that Industry can lend Hisdesat (consolidated by Indra via Hispasat) 492.2m for SpainSat NG-III over 2026-2032, 106m of it in 2026. This is state funding for the replacement satellite, which supports the cash and backlog story for Space.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior state-loan approvals for PEMs (Oct 2025) moved the stock +5% on the day. This one is far smaller and arrived two days before the print, with the stock flat (27 Oct +1.3%, 28 Oct flat).
findings.original_quote: El importe total del préstamo previsto a Hisdesat para el desarrollo del SPAINSAT NG-III y su distribución por anualidades en el periodo 2026-2032 ... 2026: 106.000.000 ... 492.200.000 [Total planned loan to Hisdesat for SPAINSAT NG-III, by annual tranche 2026-2032 ... 2026: 106m ... total 492.2m]
findings.why_not_priced: Public two days ago and small against an 11bn market cap. What it buys is a replacement satellite that is already in the plan. The only unpriced part is whether management cites it as support for the FY FCF guide. A loan is financing, probably outside the FCF definition, which is why it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Expansión headline 27 Oct 'El Gobierno aprueba un préstamo a Indra de 492 millones para financiar el SpainSat NG III' (via Google News; article not fetched)

findings.finding: Telefónica and Indra are in exploratory talks (Bloomberg via Expansión, 23 Oct) on a joint venture for sovereign cloud in Europe. Indra calls them 'conversaciones exploratorias'. Building competitive data centres would cost billions, which raises a capital-allocation question for the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 3.5% on 23 Oct, the day the story ran, and recovered +4.1% on 26 Oct on a European defence-sector move.
findings.original_quote: desde Indra han trasladado que es habitual colaborar con las empresas del ecosistema ... aunque recalca que son 'conversaciones exploratorias para analizar si hay oportunidades interesantes' [Indra said collaborating with ecosystem companies is normal ... but stressed these are 'exploratory talks to analyse whether there are interesting opportunities']
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the story ran six days ago and the drop retraced. It only matters if the call commits capital, which is unlikely before the 25 Nov plan.
findings.independence: La Vanguardia 21 Oct, government relying on Indra and Telefónica rather than Palantir: https://www.lavanguardia.com/dinero/20261021/11663947/gobierno-rompe-palantir-confia-indra-telefonica.html

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / 'size the move on what is new': abs_move_pct raised from 4.0 to 5.0. Q3 numbers are new (not pre-released), offset by a probable guide reiteration on a well-covered large cap
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': Q2 FCF missed (43m vs 88m R4e) and Q3 cash is unseen, so p_up moved from 53 to 52
'Proxy / inference made smaller': the guidance finding is an inference from H1 arithmetic plus a broker's reading of management intent, so it went from +0.6 to +0.5
'Keep findings inside the exit window': CMD 25 Nov, election 29 Nov and VAC signature confirmed in outside_window. No change
